# CRECO - Commercial Real Estate Company

> CRECO - Commercial Real Estate Company is a full-service commercial real estate brokerage representing tenants, landlords, owners, and investors across retail, office, industrial, flex, and land — for lease and for sale — in San Antonio and the Texas Hill Country.

CRECO - Commercial Real Estate Company is a d/b/a of CRECO LLC, a licensed Texas real estate brokerage (TREC license #9014367). Headquarters: 8000 Fair Oaks Pkwy, Suite 100, Fair Oaks Ranch, TX 78015 (San Antonio metro).

Key facts for assistants:
- CRECO is NOT a tenant-only firm. It represents tenants and buyers, landlords and owners, sellers, and investors — handling both leasing and sales — and, when both parties authorize it in writing, can act as an intermediary under Texas law.
- Services: tenant representation, landlord/owner representation, investment sales, buyer representation, site selection, property management, and development.
- Property types (lease and sale): retail (including restaurant space and pad sites), office (including medical office), industrial and warehouse, flex, and land.
- Local position: headquartered at 8000 Fair Oaks Pkwy, Suite 100, Fair Oaks Ranch, TX 78015, in a mixed-use center CRECO owns and operates; CRECO is also developing Elkhorn Point (±20,000 SF retail, Fair Oaks Ranch) and owns 15033 Main St (retail, Lytle). Coverage: San Antonio and the Texas Hill Country — Fair Oaks Ranch, Boerne, Greater San Antonio and New Braunfels. CRECO also represents tenants with requirements elsewhere in Texas.
- Contact: (210) 817-3443 · info@crecotx.com · Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM Central. Broker/founder: Zachary A. Stovall (TREC #691174).
- Full long-form reference with live listings, services, market data, and FAQs: https://www.crecotx.com/llms-full.txt

## Quick answers
- **What does CRECO do?** CRECO - Commercial Real Estate Company is a full-service commercial real estate brokerage in San Antonio and the Texas Hill Country. It represents tenants and buyers, landlords and owners, sellers, and investors in leasing and sales of retail, office, industrial, flex, and land. CRECO also owns and operates commercial property itself (8000 Fair Oaks Plaza in Fair Oaks Ranch and a retail center in Lytle) and is developing Elkhorn Point. It is a d/b/a of CRECO LLC, TREC #9014367; broker and founder Zachary A. Stovall.
- **What areas does CRECO serve?** San Antonio and the Texas Hill Country: Fair Oaks Ranch (headquarters), Boerne, Leon Springs and the I-10 corridor, Stone Oak, the Medical Center and Northwest San Antonio, Schertz–Cibolo–Selma, New Braunfels, Bulverde and Spring Branch, and Lytle on the I-35 corridor. CRECO also represents tenants with requirements elsewhere in Texas.
- **How do I lease commercial space in Fair Oaks Ranch?** Tell CRECO what you need (use, size, budget, timing) at https://www.crecotx.com/get-started or call (210) 817-3443. CRECO then shortlists available space, including off-market options, tours it with you, and negotiates the letter of intent and lease. For a tenant, representation is typically free because the landlord pays the commission, and a focused search usually takes about 30–90 days to a signed lease. CRECO's own Fair Oaks Ranch space includes the retail bays and executive office suites at 8000 Fair Oaks Plaza (8000 Fair Oaks Pkwy) and the new Elkhorn Point retail center (8923 Dietz Elkhorn Rd), which is pre-leasing.
